newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint steady vs basket, ends easier vs dlr.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint steady vs basket, ends easier vs dlr.

text.p: Hungary's forint remained steady against the currency basket in slow trading on Tuesday but closed weaker against the dollar as the mark eased versus the U.S. currency, dealers said.
The forint finished at 155.42/47 to the dollar, down from 155.30/35 at midday and 155.18/23 at the opening.
"The mark weakened against the dollar, too," Budapest Bank's Gabriella Markus said. "The forint remained at the (National Bank of Hungary) bid."
The forint floats in the National Bank of Hungary's 4.5 percent wide intervention band, against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the Ecu.

Dealers said the forint was not likely to be influenced by news about the U.S. election or Russian President Boris Yeltsin's heart surgery, and it will probably remain pinned to the NBH resistance level.
Swiss franc deals made up most of the Budapest Commodity Exchange's foreign currency futures turnover, with the franc dropping for four maturities.
The dollar, the mark and the yen eased for certain maturities, while the Ecu moved upwards.
